title: Krytical Nova - Volume 4 (ambience)
note: Ambience beds for Concord and Transit Row (owner, 21 Oct 2026): the sound of the place under the music, from the sound library in Drive (real recordings, found with the sound-scout skill). They play here at about the level the game would give them under the music, so they are quiet on purpose. Over the bed plays one under Concord's walking music or the Transit Row bed you marked. The game version gets a seamless loop when it is baked.

slots.place: Concord walking music (kept, for listening under)
slots.when: Heroes Gathering Plaza, already in the game. Here so the ambience can be heard under it.
Always on in Concord in daylight, under the walking music: the market round the Central Plaza. Pick one, or Maybe several to blend.
slots.ends: Crossfades to the night bed at dusk (day/night is built: row 41).

slots.when: Concord after dark: quieter, insects, a far-off town.
slots.ends: Crossfades back to the day bed at dawn.

slots.place: Concord fountain (a 3D sound at the plaza fountain)
slots.when: Heard near the fountain only, louder as the player walks up to it. Optional: say none if the plaza has no fountain you want heard.
Always on in Transit Row: wind through dead traffic, the fallen rail, a city that stopped. Pick one, or Maybe several to blend.
slots.ends: The map has no music yet; this is its whole sound out of a fight for now.

slots.place: Transit Row: dead holo-ad buzz (a layer)
slots.when: The electrical buzz of the flickering holo-ads, under the bed (or a 3D sound on the signs). Over the bed plays it under the Transit Row bed you marked Keep.
slots.ends: Fades with distance when it is a 3D sound.

cues.tags: Market murmur round the Central Plaza, footsteps, birds; a crowd with no words you can pick out.
The same town after dark: insects, distant life, quiet.
Running water for the plaza fountain.
Wind through dead traffic, the fallen elevated rail creaking, a city that stopped.
Electrical buzz of broken, flickering holo-ads.
